contribution.position: Holding my earlier position, and answering product's claim that on reliability 'nobody else sees a problem, so I would treat it as settled': that is factually wrong — the reliability concern was raised in this very transcript and is anchored in artifact:incident-log, which product did not address. The 30-day error rate of 1.8% against a 0.3% SLO plus two sev2 incidents means the service is already outside its error budget. I also answer qa: artifact:test-report (412 passed, 0 failed, 87% coverage) validates the change in isolation, not the health of the system receiving it — green tests do not erase an active SLO breach. No new artifact has appeared since my last turn that would change this: the runbook and perf report speak to operability and isolated performance, not to the live error budget. Shipping now compounds a degraded service and destroys attribution for any new errors.
